actions: Always issue fire, or alternate fire/wait starting with fire. Both retain the exact rule steering and hard no-ammo/pacifist constraints. Reset step parity per episode.
design_timing: Added after main training started but before any development evaluation results were available. Frozen main protocol, sources, selection and primary gate remain unchanged.
reason: A learned firing controller could improve rules by learning a trivial firing pattern. These explicit simple policies bound that interpretation.
seeds: Exactly the completed parent development or confirmation seeds; no additional model fitting or selection.
claim_boundary: Additional descriptive controls, outside the original primary comparison family. They cannot rescue or change the frozen gate. A gain over rules alone cannot establish a nontrivial learned mechanism if these controls explain it.
